statements.status_notes: This npm @sigstore/core package is a bundled dependency of the npm CLI shipped inside the Node.js 20 runtime that actions/runner vendors for running JavaScript-based GitHub Actions (node_modules/npm/node_modules/@sigstore/core). The fix crosses a major version boundary (1.x to 3.x); DHI does not control npm's internal dependency versions in any case, as they are pinned by the upstream Node.js release actions/runner bundles. Remediation requires either an upstream actions-runner release bundling a newer Node.js/npm, or an npm-side patch.
